newsitem.title: USA: CBOT wheat seen down 2-3 cts, exports trim losses.
newsitem.headline: CBOT wheat seen down 2-3 cts, exports trim losses.

text.p: CBOT wheat futures were expected to open two to three cents per bushel lower on USDA crop production data, but strong weekly exports could cap losses, traders said.
USDA forecast total winter wheat production at 1.604 billion bushels. That was slightly above the trade average of 1.579 billion bushels.
However, weekly export sales data were expected to limit losses, traders said. Sales of 562,500 tonnes were above expectations for 200,000 to 450,000 tonnes.
